news.title: FIIs cut stakes in 12 stocks in September quarter; shares fall up to 27% in 3 months

news.title: FII ownership hits 17-year low, but foreign holdings in Indian equities rise 3.6 times to $783 billion: Report
news.summary: Foreign investor ownership in Indian equities has fallen to a 17-year low of 15.1%, but the absolute value of holdings has risen to around $783 billion. OmniScience Capital attributes the decline in ownership share to faster growth in domestic investor participation.

news.title: Global Market: Goldman Sachs raises December Brent oil price forecast to $90 on supply risks
news.summary: Goldman Sachs has raised its December 2026 Brent crude price forecast to $90 per barrel, citing supply risks in the Middle East. While 2027 averages remain at $80, severe Gulf production cuts could drive prices to $125, even as potential Russian exports keep near-term market sentiment volatile.
